title: Siege of Toul
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Toul", at revision 1370745911, opens: "The siege of Toul was the siege of the fortified French town of Toul from 16 August to 23 September 1870 by Prussian, Bavarian and Württemberg forces during the Franco-Prussian War. Toul controlled a railway line leading to Germany and it was vital for the Germans to secure it to resupply and reinforce their armies in northern France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q815217, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1870 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
